Use case: ui-mockup. Create a realistic, production-quality desktop professional fireworks authoring inspector UI. One focused parameter panel ONLY, natural 720 x 1440 px portrait canvas, no device frame and no browser chrome. Today's anchor is 2026-10-10; no dates needed on-screen. The user wants faithful visual alternatives of an existing Chinese desktop product, not new features. Reference image 1 is the existing same-content S/C sample with exact field values, links and readonly curves. Reference image 2 is the actual 4.9.68 product for brand colors, hierarchy and genuine supported controls. Use references as grounding, but output ONE design only.
Hard palette invariants: background #111d21, panel #1b2a2f, subtle elevated surface #24373d, accent #00d49b, primary text #e4edef, secondary text #b4c5cb. No warm green or new theme. Flat professional tool surface, simple thin dividers, purposeful spacing; no nested cards, gratuitous metrics, marketing text, invented nav or decorations. Body text14-16 px, compact normal rows30-36 px, tabular numeric text. Keep all controls readable and unclipped.
Top identity in Chinese: "烟花烘焙器 / 效果制作"; object "千轮 › 第 1 层 › 子花"; small scope "仅作用当前层的子花". Minimal status labels "配方未保存" and "贴图旧", "自动烘焙关". Stable active-object identity always visible.
Exactly the SAME SIX showcased fields in every visual, with exact values and supported capabilities: 大小 1.20 m, manual with "接回" and source "同主星 0.60 m"; 大小随寿命 text "0:1, 0.7:1, 1:0" and readonly miniature line graph, plateau until0.7 then falls to0 at1, horizontal normalized particle lifetime, no draggable handles. 亮度 1.00 × with "跟着算" source同主星的亮度; 亮度随寿命 text "空 = ×1", readonly constant-one graph. 终端速度20.0 m/s with跟着算同主层终端速度; 重力倍率1.00 × with跟着算同主层重力倍率. Numeric controls use ordinary slider+exact number+unit, source on next line, direct edit can detach; do not gray out values so strongly they look unavailable. No fake random buttons, no independent subflower color, no invented particle simulation knobs. Other actual parameters remain behind normal collapsed module headings, no nested "更多". Curves are TEXT EDITOR + READONLY GRAPH, absolutely no drag points.
Use E1 task state for this still frame: user has deliberately entered size/brightness adjustment; relevant modules expanded, user choice takes precedence. This is a proposed still, not proof that scroll/focus memory works. At bottom plain compact actions "撤销" "重做" "恢复打开时"; small static annotation "E1 · 按任务展开，返回当前编辑位置" outside active control rows. One help block "大小：子花单颗星的直径"; detail "单位 m。直接输入断开主星联动；接回跟随主星。曲线横轴为寿命，纵轴为直径倍数。". Keep same six-field content, status, typography and row spacing across variants. All18 real applicable definitions retained by architecture; show the focused task rather than inventory. Do not add a primary save/import action at bottom. Top variant title will be supplied below. Do not write numeric option labels.
